Admitted with 4 days fever, productive cough and breathlessness. RR 26, SpO2 91% on room air, crepitations right lower zone. Started on amoxicillin-clavulanate; oxygen and supportive care. Chest X-ray pending.

Known hypertensive, non-compliant with medicines. Presented with severe headache and blurred vision. BP 188/112, no focal neuro deficit. Admitted for BP control and observation; amlodipine restarted, strict I/O.

Known T2DM, stopped oral meds for 1 week. Admitted with polyuria, polydipsia and fatigue. Capillary glucose high; started on regular insulin with monitoring. Rehydrate, diabetic diet, education before discharge.
Brought to ER with acute breathlessness and audible wheeze for 2 hours. Unable to complete sentences; SpO2 88% on air. Nebulised levosalbutamol started, oxygen via mask, continuous monitoring.
ER: crushing left-sided chest pain radiating to left arm for 45 minutes, diaphoresis. ECG pending. Loading clopidogrel given, oxygen, continuous cardiac monitoring; urgent cardiology consult.
